node.title: N=256 2-adic cofactor collision exclusion
node.statement: For a first-band N=256,s=5 folded vector, let mu be the multiplicity at X=1 of its nonzero mod-two reduction. Total ramification gives mu=v_2(|Norm(alpha)|). If a live prime p>2^250 divides the norm, the folded-L2 bounds force a cofactor below 64 in profile (3,4,0) and below 2^17 in profile (4,2,0). Hence mu<=5 and mu<=16, respectively. In the two-singleton profile this says their exponent separation is not divisible by 32.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: adds exact 2-adic necessary conditions to both first-band N=256 profiles. Passing the tests is not sufficient, and neither profile nor the total ledger is closed.
